CustomStickerPack.title: CustomStickerPack
CustomStickerPack.description: A user-created or saved WhatsApp sticker pack containing pack metadata and stickers.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this sticker pack.

title.description: The display title of the sticker pack (3-60 characters).

author.description: The creator/publisher name of the sticker pack (2-50 characters).

category.description: Category tag such as Gaisuwa, Barkwanci, Biki, Addu'a, Kasuwanci, or Na Musamman.

trayEmoji.description: Primary emoji icon for the sticker pack tray.

accentColorHex.description: Hex color code for the pack theme.

isFavorite.description: Whether the user marked this pack as a favorite.

stickersCount.description: Number of stickers inside this pack (1 to 30).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the pack was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the pack was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CustomStickerItem.title: CustomStickerItem
CustomStickerItem.description: An individual custom sticker designed by a user in the Sticker Studio.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this custom sticker.

packId.description: The ID of the pack this sticker belongs to.

topText.description: Main Hausa or custom phrase on the sticker (1-60 characters).

bottomText.description: Secondary subtitle or translation on the sticker (0-60 characters).

shapeStyle.description: Badge shape style: CIRCLE, STARBURST, SHIELD, HEXAGON, or BANNER.

isFavorite.description: Whether the user marked this individual sticker as favorite.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the sticker was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the sticker was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/sticker_packs/{packId}.description: Stores custom and saved WhatsApp sticker packs owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/custom_stickers/{sticker.description: Stores individual custom stickers created in the Sticker Studio owned by the user.
